disposition_reason: Table 1 prints Cd, Ni and Pb (µg/kg) for 16 composite peeled-banana samples from 11 Ecuadorian provinces.

study.design: 16 composite banana samples (each 5 subsamples) from 11 Ecuadorian production provinces; triplicate analysis with fortification QC
study.origin: Azuay, Bolívar, Cañar, Cotopaxi, El Oro, Esmeraldas, Guayas, Los Ríos, Manabí, Santa Elena and Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas provinces, Ecuador
study.market: randomly chosen local commercial establishments within each sampling location
study.method: GFAAS (Perkin Elmer HGA 900 / AAnalyst 400) after HNO3/H2O2 microwave digestion (MARS 6) of ~1 g dried peeled pulp
study.lod_text: Fortification at each metal's quantification limit level: Cd 12.5 µg/kg, Ni and Pb 125 µg/kg (LOQ not otherwise stated)
study.qa: Fortification recoveries 80.6-119.8% per sample (Table 1 'accuracy'); repeatability RSD 0.33-7.77%; AOAC criteria 75-120%; calibration with certified standards
